So loyalty=1 (tattle-tale violates loyalty), authority=1 (both poles relate to authority: tattle-tale supports authority, f***-the-police opposes), liberty=1 (f***-the-police). Notes: tattle-tale is disloyal; f***-the-police is anti-authority/pro-liberty.

Prideful could be authority (arrogance). I'd say fairness=1 for envy (desire for equal distribution), general=1 for both vices. Also purity? Pride is a sin. But not strong.
